name: nintedanib
warnings: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hepatic impairment: Nintedanib Capsules is not recommended for use in patients with moderate or severe hepatic impairment. In patients with mild hepatic impairment (Child Pugh A), the recommended dosage is 100 mg twice daily approximately 12 hours apart taken with food. Co
